core_reconciliation.decision: The v1 sidecar owns its finite Hub contract in-tree and does not pin either external core.
core_reconciliation.reason: The fork source was ahead of the published package. Keeping the eight hand-authored operations in one compiled source removes that unresolved source identity from the app-state pin; the binary sha256 remains the authority.

measurement.note: The real-box gate must measure checkpoint install cost before activating this fallback.
